calls.note: Do not invest after the vertical rise above Rs 5,000 because fundamentals do not support the move; the activity is highly speculative.
Some underlying business exists, but the stock is highly risky and speculative and can lose most of its value; do not follow a marquee investor blindly.
Investors who accept SME liquidity risk may add slowly on dips; it is a distinctive defence and submarine-sector company, with main-board direction expected within about three months.
Book partial profit around Rs 1,300-1,400 after the vertical rise and high near-term valuation; the aerospace business remains strong and can be reconsidered on dips.
